integrity: Every formula is derived from two-sided additive-ideal conditions. Finite-field checks are confirmatory, not general proofs.
scientific_limitations: Exact for strictly upper triangular 4-by-4 rings over finite fields; extension to n>=5 not asserted. Independent audit not performed. A mathematically equivalent count could remain in unindexed literature.
title: Additive ideal-size zeta polynomial of the four-by-four niltriangular ring over every finite field
